title: Lock In settings
description: Everything Lock In keeps that isn't a session, stored as ~/.lockin/settings.json: profiles, the plan for the next session, and bookkeeping between launches. If this file can't be read, Lock In saves nothing until it's fixed, so it's never overwritten.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, for editors that validate JSON.

active_session.description: What the open session enforces. Present only while a session is open.

profile.description: A copy of the profile taken when the session started, so editing the profile doesn't change what's enforced.

hardcore.description: Hardcore Mode: the session can't be ended, paused for an update or quit until its target is reached.

plan.description: The next session, as planned on the Focus page.

pending_review_session_id.description: The finished session waiting for its review.

resume_after_update_interval_id.description: The pause an update created. On the next launch, work resumes if that pause is still the current interval.

last_backfill.description: What the last `lockin backfill` changed, so `lockin backfill --undo` can put it back.

created_session.description: The backfill created the session, so undoing it removes the session.

websites.description: Rules such as reddit.com or youtube.com/shorts. Subdomains match; paths match by prefix.

blocking_mode.description: block: the websites are blocked. allow: everything except the websites is blocked.

hooks.description: Shell scripts run through /bin/zsh, by event: start, stop, overtime, break, resume, pause.

password_hash.description: Gates editing the profile. Not a security boundary.
